stem.text: A uniform cylinder of weight $25.0\,\text{N}$ is suspended from a newton meter.
The cylinder is fully submerged in water, as shown.
The reading on the newton meter is $10.0\,\text{N}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a newton meter hanging over a beaker of water. A cylinder hangs from the newton meter hook and is fully submerged in the water. Labels: newton meter, cylinder, water.

stem.text: The water is replaced by a liquid with a density 10% greater than the density of water. The cylinder remains fully submerged.
What is the new reading on the newton meter?
